stages.title: Repository and governance bootstrap
stages.exit_gate: Repository and governance artifacts are present at the exact baseline without claiming publication readiness.

stages.title: Fixed provider-free reference proofs
stages.exit_gate: Frozen M0, M1, verified-change, and terminal projection contracts remain present with all documented non-claims.

stages.title: Protected-review routing and attestation slice
stages.exit_gate: The bounded protected-review route and attestation slice is present while its trust and runtime non-claims remain explicit.

stages.title: Governance and source convergence
stages.exit_gate: Accepted authority and branch-flow decisions, reviewed freeze disposition, consistent machine and prose policy, synchronized issue 32 and roadmap, green validation, and paired independent QA.

stages.title: Donor characterization and design decisions
stages.exit_gate: Pinned donor characterization and accepted decisions cover component homes, runtime, persistence, identity, effects, privacy, compatibility, and rollback implications.

stages.title: Versioned connective contracts
stages.exit_gate: Versioned schemas, fixtures, evolution rules, property tests, and adversarial QA cover controller, delegation, authority, event, effect, storage, and pin contracts.

stages.title: Portable executive controller
stages.exit_gate: A durable reference controller passes conformance, scheduling, duplicate, restart, stale-writer, cancellation, exhaustion, and recovery tests without claiming deterministic semantic judgment.

stages.title: Telos delegation dispatcher
stages.exit_gate: At-least-once delegated delivery is idempotently admitted, replay-safe, cancellable, crash-resumable, reconcilable, and separately adjudicable by Telos.

stages.title: Selected runtime and model adapters
stages.exit_gate: The selected runtime and scoped effect and QA paths enforce principal, credential, routing, outcome, expiry, and duplicate-effect boundaries.

stages.title: Pinned integration skeleton
stages.exit_gate: A clean environment resolves exact compatible component pins, preserves and replays durable evidence, passes cross-component contracts, and rolls back to a known-good checkpoint.

stages.title: Authentic bounded vertical slice
stages.exit_gate: One bounded authenticated effect survives forced retries, duplicates, crash/restart, cancellation, replay, QA, separate Telos adjudication, and rollback under exact pins.

stages.title: Cognitive programs
stages.exit_gate: One discipline and then the development pipeline conform across fake and reference runtimes without donor runtime coupling.

stages.title: Read-only live observability
stages.exit_gate: Read-only views replay real persisted events, explain causal state and missing evidence, enforce privacy, and expose no command authority.

stages.title: Attach and composition hardening
stages.exit_gate: Clean install, restart, upgrade, rollback, identity, reconnect, isolation, command-length, and security drills pass against exact pins.

stages.title: Release and publication
stages.exit_gate: License, audit, distinct protected trust root, protected main, post-merge evidence, independent approval, rollback, and immutable tag bind one full main SHA.
